set_value.name: $healthy
set_value.exact: player.spacesuit.exists and player.controlled == player.spacesuit and player.entity.controlled == player.spacesuit and (not player.room.exists or player.room.hascontext.{player.spacesuit}) and not player.entity.isintransit

debug_text.text: 'GO spacesuit state v46: request=%1 phase=%2 source=%3 ship=%4 controlled=%5 entity_controlled=%6 suit=%7 room=%8 transit=%9'.[Init.$Serial,Init.$Stage,Init.$Source,player.ship,player.controlled,player.entity.controlled,player.spacesuit,player.room,player.entity.isintransit]

do_if.value: not Init.$Pending and not $healthy and $source.exists and $source.isclass.ship and not $source.isclass.spacesuit and $zone.isclass.zone and $source.sector == $zone.sector and $source.sector == player.sector and not @$source.dock.container.exists and (player.room.hascontext.{$source} or player.ship == $source or player.spacesuit.exists)

debug_text.text: 'GO spacesuit exit requested v46: source=%1 controlled=%2 suit=%3 room=%4'.[$source,player.controlled,player.spacesuit,player.room]
'GO spacesuit rollback v46: rebuilding original ship context, request=%1'.[Init.$Serial]
'GO spacesuit rollback command returned v46: request=%1'.[Init.$Serial]

write_to_logbook.title: 'Galactic Occupations: spacesuit handoff verified'
write_to_logbook.text: 'The confirmed exit now has the player and native control in the same spacesuit, outside the original ship room. Recovery stopped. Ship crew, equipment and orders were preserved.'

do_elseif.value: not Init.$Source.exists or player.sector != Init.$Sector or Init.$Source.sector != Init.$Sector or @Init.$Source.dock.container.exists or player.occupiedship.exists or (player.controlled.exists and not player.controlled.isclass.spacesuit) or (player.room.exists and player.room != Init.$Room and (Init.$Stage == 0 or not player.room.hascontext.{Init.$Source})) or (player.ship.exists and player.ship != Init.$Source and not player.ship.isclass.spacesuit)

debug_text.text: 'GO spacesuit recovery cancelled v46: player or source context changed'

do_elseif.value: player.age gt Init.$Expires or (Init.$Stage == 3 and player.age ge Init.$Due and not player.entity.isintransit)

write_to_logbook.title: if Init.$Stage == 3 and Init.$ResetObserved and player.room.hascontext.{Init.$Source} and not player.entity.isintransit then 'Galactic Occupations: returned to original ship' else 'Galactic Occupations: spacesuit handoff still blocked'
write_to_logbook.text: 'The bounded recovery has stopped. See GO spacesuit state v46 in the debug log for the observed ship, room, suit, control and transit state. No further automatic exits or teleports will run for this request. A ship-room return is not verification that spacesuit controls work.'

do_elseif.value: player.age ge Init.$Due and not player.isinconversation

do_if.value: Init.$Stage == 0 and (not player.entity.isintransit or player.age ge Init.$Started + 30s)

debug_text.text: 'GO spacesuit reset v46: rebuilding source room before exit, request=%1'.[Init.$Serial]
'GO spacesuit reset command returned v46: request=%1'.[Init.$Serial]

write_to_logbook.title: 'Galactic Occupations: source ship unavailable for recovery'
write_to_logbook.text: 'The game refused forced teleport permission to the original ship. No ship reset or further automatic exit was attempted.'

do_if.value: Init.$ResetObserved and not player.entity.isintransit and player.room.hascontext.{Init.$Source}

debug_text.text: 'GO spacesuit exit v46: source room restored, one native emergency exit, request=%1'.[Init.$Serial]
'GO spacesuit exit command returned v46: request=%1'.[Init.$Serial]

do_elseif.value: Init.$Stage == 2 and (not player.entity.isintransit or player.age ge Init.$Expires - 5s) and player.canforceteleportto.{Init.$Source}

debug_text.text: 'GO spacesuit source teleport observed v46: request=%1 phase=%2 room=%3'.[Init.$Serial,Init.$Stage,event.param]
